Settings.Title: Traffic Lights & Lanes
Settings.AutoManageAll.Label: Manage all traffic lights automatically
Settings.AutoManageAll.Description: TLL takes over every signalled junction, builds a phase plan from its layout and adjusts the timing to the measured traffic. Junctions you configured yourself are left alone. Level crossings and movable bridges stay with the game.
Settings.AutoMode.Label: Control mode for automatic junctions
Settings.AutoMode.Description: Automatic: the autopilot decides; junctions outside green waves run adaptive. Adaptive: the phase with the most pressure goes next, and green adapts to traffic. Actuated: phases in fixed order, skipped without demand, green ends when the queue is gone. Fixed time: fixed greens, optimised every few minutes.
Settings.AutoLayout.Label: Phase layout for automatic junctions
Settings.AutoLayout.Description: Automatic: the autopilot compares all layouts with the traffic measured at each junction over days and picks the one with the least waiting. Permissive: oncoming traffic runs together, turning traffic gives way. Protected turns: turns across oncoming traffic get their own green. Split: one approach at a time. Pedestrian scramble: an extra phase in which only pedestrians walk.
Settings.AutoFlash.Label: Flashing yellow at low traffic
Settings.AutoFlash.Description: When a junction is quiet enough for priority rules, its signals flash yellow: the main road passes, the side roads give way. Signals come back as traffic grows. Separate thresholds for on and off keep it from flickering.
Settings.TurnOnRed.Label: Turn on red
Settings.TurnOnRed.Description: Right turns (left turns in left-hand traffic) stop at red and may then go when the way is clear. Only where they meet nothing but traffic they give way to. As in the US, Canada, and with the German green arrow.
Settings.KeepClear.Label: Keep junctions clear
Settings.KeepClear.Description: A lane stays red while its exit is backed up to the junction, so nobody gets stuck in the middle and blocks the cross traffic.
Settings.AutoGreenWaves.Label: Automatic green waves
Settings.AutoGreenWaves.Description: Finds main roads with signals close together and times them as green waves in both directions. Recalculated every few minutes from the measured traffic.
Settings.ReleaseAll.Label: Return all junctions to the game
Settings.ReleaseAll.Description: Removes TLL's control from every junction, including the ones you configured. The game rebuilds its own signal groups.
Settings.ReleaseAll.Warning: Return all junctions to the game's control? Your own phase plans are lost.
Settings.RebuildVanilla.Label: Repair signal data from other mods
Settings.RebuildVanilla.Description: Makes the game rebuild the signal groups of every junction TLL does not manage. Use it once after removing another traffic light mod, whose settings can stay behind in the save.
Settings.RebuildVanilla.Warning: Rebuild the signal groups of all junctions not managed by TLL?
Settings.VerboseLogging.Label: Detailed log
Settings.VerboseLogging.Description: Writes one line per junction plan to Logs/TLL.log. Useful when reporting a problem.
Panel.Title: Traffic Lights & Lanes
Panel.Unavailable: The game has changed in a way TLL does not recognise. All traffic lights are left to the game.
Panel.NoProblems: No junction is struggling right now.
Panel.CoordinatedNote: Runs in a green wave. Choose another mode to take it out.
Panel.PickJunction: Pick a junction on the map
Panel.VanillaSignals: The game controls these traffic lights.
Panel.Roundabout: A roundabout: traffic entering gives way to traffic in the ring. Traffic lights are not used here.
Panel.NoSignals: This junction has no traffic lights. Add them with the game's intersection upgrade.
